ITEM.PTXT: A front passenger power seat with power slide and power reclining mechanisms has been provided on the Master G grade of 2GR-FE engine models. Each mechanism is the same as that of the driver side power seat.

The slide mechanism of the front passenger power seat provides an adjustment range of approximately 240mm in total fore and aft, and the reclining adjustment angle is 6° forward and 44° rearward from the neutral position.
Provided on all models except standard grade
